news.headline: Microsoft Releases Preliminary Report on Recent 365 Service Outage
news.summary: Microsoft issued a preliminary post-incident report attributing the recent Microsoft 365 service disruption to a latent software defect and network capacity issues.

news.headline: Teamsters Organize Rally for Terminated Amazon Delivery Drivers in New York City
news.summary: The Teamsters union is organizing a rally to support 200 delivery drivers who were dismissed after Amazon terminated its contract with their third-party employer.

news.headline: Instagram Launches Integration for Amazon Affiliate Links
news.summary: Instagram has introduced a new feature allowing creators to directly integrate Amazon affiliate links into Reels and feed posts.

news.headline: Apple Releases iOS 27.3 Developer Beta Featuring 'Face Unlock' for iPhone Duo
news.summary: Apple's latest iOS 27.3 developer beta introduces a new software-based 'face unlock' feature specifically for the iPhone Duo.

news.headline: Apple Appoints 26-Year Veteran Corey Fugman to Lead Payments and Wallet Unit
news.summary: Apple has named company veteran Corey Fugman to head its payments and digital wallet division, which oversees Apple Pay, Apple Card, and Wallet services.

news.headline: JPMorgan Chase Discloses 5.22% Stake in Sibanye-Stillwater
news.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. has formally notified that it has acquired a 5.22% interest in the issued share capital of Sibanye-Stillwater.

news.headline: JPMorgan Chase and Other Major Banks Experience Online Banking Outages
news.summary: Customers reported widespread difficulties accessing online banking services at JPMorgan Chase and other major financial institutions on November 16, 2026.

news.headline: Apple and OpenEvidence Launch Virtual Health AI Research Study
news.summary: Apple has initiated a virtual research study in collaboration with OpenEvidence to investigate how consumers utilize conversational artificial intelligence for health-related purposes.

news.headline: Amnesty International Reports Continued Labor Issues at Amazon Saudi Arabia Facilities
news.summary: Amnesty International has alleged that migrant workers at Amazon facilities in Saudi Arabia continue to face exploitation, including misleading recruitment practices and wage issues.

news.headline: NVIDIA Announces Quantum Computing Collaborations with IBM and Fermilab
news.summary: NVIDIA is partnering with IBM and the Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory to advance quantum computing research, including a new modular codesign platform and a high-speed decoding algorithm.

news.headline: NVIDIA Introduces Nemotron for Science Platform
news.summary: NVIDIA launched 'NVIDIA Nemotron for Science,' a new platform designed to help researchers build specialized AI agents for scientific discovery, including a new chemistry dataset.

news.headline: NVIDIA Launches Vera CPU Platform for High-Performance Computing
news.summary: NVIDIA announced the 'NVIDIA Vera CPU' rack-scale platform, its first custom data center CPU designed for high-performance scientific modeling and simulation.

news.headline: Thread AI Joins Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program
news.summary: Thread AI has been accepted into the Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program, providing the company with access to Azure AI models and enterprise-grade support.

news.headline: Tesla Announces €3 Billion Expansion of German Gigafactory
news.summary: Tesla plans to invest €3 billion ($3.31 billion) to expand its manufacturing facility in Gruenheide, Germany, to increase production capacity for its Cybercab autonomous vehicles.

news.headline: Microsoft Addresses Recent 365 Service Disruption
news.summary: Microsoft has implemented new service health check methods and automated recovery systems following a global disruption to its 365 services that occurred between November 12 and 14, 2026.

news.headline: Corvex Signs $103 Million Agreement for NVIDIA Blackwell Capacity
news.summary: AI cloud computing firm Corvex has entered into a $103 million take-or-pay agreement to secure NVIDIA Blackwell GPU capacity.
